newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah not traded on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah not traded on Monday.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was not traded on Monday as financial markets were closed on the last day of the local financial year.
On Thursday, overnight money fluctuated between 15.0 and 19.0 percent in the afternoon before settling at 17.0/18.0 percent.
Spot rupiah was at 2,401.00/01.75 at 0900 GMT on Thursday, compared with an opening of 2,401.50/02.50. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,401.0/01.5 and 2,398.25/99.00, respectively.
The market, which was also closed on Friday for the Good Friday holiday, reopens on Tuesday.
